outputs.explanation: Panel A shows representative pseudocoloured microscopy images of photoactivation experiments with no quantification or statistics, so replicate reporting is not required.

replicate_statements: Graphs representing normalized intensities measured during relaxation in the circled regions of the experiment displayed in (A)
Insets represent average early time points responses measured in euchromatin and heterochromatin (red and green data sets, respectively) to emphasize on the initial plateau in heterochromatin.
outputs.explanation: Panel B plots quantified intensity data with error bars (implying averaging over some number of measurements/experiments), but the legend never states how many replicates (n) were used or what kind of replicate they represent (e.g., independent experiments, cells, ROIs).
